customer_persona: Buyers looking for a compact SUV for daily urban commuting, weekend family travel, or flexible highway trips. They value certified crash protection, functional everyday comfort, and a choice of fuel and gearbox configurations to suit their lifestyle.
decision_frame: The strongest supported fit is a compact SUV engineered with standard six airbags, five-star crash test ratings, and flexible fuel setups, while the essential step remaining is to test drive your preferred powertrain and verify local on-road pricing with an authorized dealer.
takeaway: The Tata Nexon combines standard five-star crash safety equipment with versatile petrol, diesel, and iCNG driving setups tailored to your routine.
primary_outcome: Choosing the right Nexon powertrain and trim based on verified safety ratings, practical dimensions, and documented cabin features.
supporting_outcomes: Comparing published petrol, diesel, and CNG boot capacities against your daily cargo needs.
Identifying trim-dependent equipment such as ventilated seating, 360-degree cameras, and advanced driver assistance.

concerns.why: Buyers want reassurance that structural safety and critical occupant protection are not reserved solely for top-tier trims.
Families need to confirm that boot space remains functional across different fuel variants, particularly with twin CNG cylinders.
Drivers want clarity on which engines pair with automatic gearboxes and how power outputs differ across petrol, diesel, and CNG.
Prospective owners want clear visibility on starting price, finance terms, and warranty coverage before visiting a showroom.

usps.name: Thoughtful cabin ventilation and comfort
usps.why_it_matters: Available front ventilated seats and standard rear air-conditioning vents help manage passenger comfort across hot Indian seasons.

usps.name: Versatile multi-powertrain and transmission options
usps.why_it_matters: Choosing between turbo petrol, turbo diesel, and dual-cylinder iCNG with manual, AMT, or dual-clutch transmissions allows you to tailor the SUV to your preferred driving routine.

usps.name: Comprehensive standard safety architecture
usps.why_it_matters: Every Nexon variant includes six airbags, electronic stability program, and ISOFIX mounts alongside certified five-star crash test results.

segments.title: Welcome to Tata Nexon

segments.goal: State the starting ex-showroom price, 3-year warranty badge, and outline open questions for dealer verification.

voice.persona_description: An articulate and courteous Tata Motors product specialist who presents technical specifications with warm clarity and strict accuracy. She avoids exaggerated claims, respects customer priorities, and highlights verified evidence.
voice.tone: Warm, confident, reassuring, and grounded in verified engineering facts.
voice.sample_line: Hello and welcome to Tata Motors! I am glad you are exploring the Nexon today, and I am here to help you inspect its features at your own pace.

intake.q1: Welcome to Tata Motors! Would you like to tell me what you're looking for in your next SUV, or shall we jump straight in?

state_questions.question: Which aspect of the Nexon would you like to examine first, such as the safety equipment, engine choices, or interior comfort?
To make sure we check the exact setup, which gearbox and fuel type do you prefer for your daily driving?
To ensure the cabin and boot match your routine, will you primarily use the car for city traffic, highway commutes, or family road trips?

do_not_recommend_if: I would not recommend the Tata Nexon if your priority requires third-row passenger seating or verified real-world fuel economy figures that are not currently published in official specifications.
advance: Take the next step by clicking 'Book Test Drive' to experience the seating comfort, driving position, and gearbox response firsthand at your local showroom.
notes: All claims adhere strictly to approved registry facts F001 through F029. Ground clearance of 208 mm is unladen and variant-dependent; it is never described as a water-wading guarantee. Crash test ratings explicitly reflect published GNCAP and BNCAP scopes. Pricing starts at Rs 7.39 Lakhs ex-showroom, and the introductory EMI of Rs 6,499 carries full terms regarding subsequent increases. Unknowns U01 through U09 are directed to dealer verification.
